profile.headline: Senior Data Software Engineer at Panasonic Avionics Corporation | Data Engineer | Software Engineer | Data Scientist |
profile.summary:
I'm currently a Senior Data Software Engineer at Panasonic Avionics, where I work heavily on the data engineering side including building ETL pipelines and analytics workflows using Python and AWS (Glue, Athena, Lambda, QuickSight, and more). My day-to-day focuses on turning raw aviation data into clean, reliable datasets that power reporting and decision-making.
 
Over time, I've taken on more ownership of production pipelines, data quality, and operational support, which has naturally pushed me toward a data engineering focus. I enjoy working on scalable systems and solving data reliability challenges across teams.
 
I have a Bachelor's in Computer Science from Cal State Fullerton and I'm currently pursuing my Master's in Computer Science with an emphasis in Data Engineering, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (GenAI).

positions.title: Senior Data Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Engineer and maintain production-grade ETL pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, SNS/SQS, S3, Athena, and Python/PySpark to ingest and process in-flight connectivity data across 20+ international airlines, enabling reliable customer-facing analytics and operational reporting dashboards.
• Migrate legacy reporting workflows to scalable AWS-based processes, automating daily, weekly, and monthly customer report delivery through AWS SES and reducing manual reporting effort by an estimated 10+ hours per month. Implement compression and delivery improvements for large reporting payloads, reducing file sizes by up to 60% and improving downstream delivery.
• Support 24x7 production reliability as part of an on-call rotation by triaging 5+ production alerts per month using CloudWatch and PagerDuty, performing root cause analysis, and executing data backfills to restore reporting completeness.
• Investigate and resolve data quality issues across connectivity sources using SQL, Athena, PySpark, and CloudWatch logs to reconcile inconsistencies and improve confidence in downstream analytics.
• Author and maintain 10+ Confluence pages, including pipeline documentation, architecture diagrams, operational runbooks, and data dictionaries, improving data discoverability, knowledge transfer, and onboarding support for new engineers.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, architecture, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable AWS data pipelines.

projects.title: Twitter Mockup (REST API) - Web Back End Engineering
projects.description:
• Built a microblogging service similar to Twitter in which each user has a username, a bio, an email address, and a
password. Each user can follow each other, and they can post messages.
• Developed two RESTful API microservices using HUG, used the sqlite3 embedded database for each service and wrote
a load balancer for the microservices.
• Implemented a data store for the service using Redis and wrote a database using Amazon DynamoDB.
• Created a service registry for the multithreaded service and periodic health checks to ensure all services are operational.

projects.title: Banker's Algorithm
projects.description:
• A C++ program that illustrates the banker’s algorithm in action. Banker’s algorithm is a standard operating system solution for resource allocation procedures from multi-threading applications. 
• Threads/customers request the banker, which only has a limited set of resources. The banker now must decide where to grant n amount of resources by determining if these particular requests might be the system into an unsafe state. If a path of allocatable recourses exists, the request is approved as this process falls under a safe condition. 
• All information is kept under several ADT (abstract data types) to validate and assign the appropriate requests by the banker.
